rationale: What I changed and why: your DNF at 0.8 km and your plan for this week (static bike, light isometric calf work, physio-approved) replace the build I wrote this morning, before the race result. 2-6 Nov is bike plus the isometrics, no running; the first run is a 20-30 min easy test on Sat 7 Nov, only if single-leg raises and gentle hops are pain-free. The 11 Nov intervals and 14 Nov tempo are withdrawn: fast reps loaded the calf on 28 Oct, so quality waits until a full week of normal running has been calf-clear, which pushes it to about the week of 23 Nov. The long-run progression and the November volume step slide back to match, as agreed on 1 Nov (the step waits for a clear week). Weeks 2 and 3 are provisional and rebuild by feel: 6-12 km runs, then ~55 km by 22 Nov. What does not change: your physio outranks this plan, the leg sessions stay (calf work kept to isometrics for now), and stopping at 0.8 km was the right call. A week or two of lost volume costs almost nothing against a strained calf; 'return before it was ready' is exactly the loop you described in the achilles years.

changes.notes: Rest. Log the race, the calf and what you took. Light isometric calf work as your physio approved.
Bike, not a run. 30-40 min on the static bike, seated, normal cadence (no big low-cadence grinding), conversational effort. Light isometric calf work per physio. No running.
Bike, not a run. 30-45 min easy on the bike. Leg gym: upper body and non-calf lower work only if pain-free; calf work stays the light isometrics your physio approved, no loaded plyometrics.

Bike, not a run. 30-45 min easy. Check at the end: 15-20 single-leg calf raises each side (straight and bent knee), then gentle hops. All pain-free is the gate for a first run; any tightness, stay on the bike.
Bike, not a run. 30-40 min easy, or a brisk walk. No running yet.

Return test. Only if the calf passed the raises and hops on Thu/Fri: 20-30 min easy run, flat, Vomeros, no strides, no pace. Stop at the first tightness and tell me. If not clean, bike 30-40 min instead and the return slides a day or two.
Bike 30-45 min easy. A second run only if Saturday felt like nothing at all, and then 25-35 min easy, flat, Vomeros.
Provisional — Rest.
Provisional — Easy 6 km, flat, Vomeros, only if the weekend run was clean. Otherwise bike.
Provisional — Bike 30-40 min easy, or leg gym (graded calf/soleus/single-leg work). The 4x1 km intervals are withdrawn: no speed until a full week of normal running is calf-clear.
Provisional — Easy 8 km, Vomeros, flat.
Provisional — Rest or light bike.
Provisional — Easy 10 km, no strides. No tempo: a week of normal running must pass first.
Provisional — Easy 12 km, ~5:00/km or slower, one gel at ~40 min for practice. Only if achilles 0, calf silent and HRV/RHR steady.
Provisional — Rest.
Provisional — Easy 10 km. Calf silent through the week, or hold at this level.
Provisional — Easy 8 km. Replaces the 5x1 km: speed returns only after a clear week of normal running, probably the week of 23 Nov, with strides first.
Provisional — Easy 8 km. Leg gym on or after today.
Provisional — Easy 6 km.
Provisional — Easy 10 km + 4 strides if the calf is silent. Tempo waits one more week.

Provisional — Long run 16 km easy (~5:00/km or slower); gel from 20 min then every ~25 min, log what you took. Week ~55 km. The 18-22 km progression restarts from here once the calf has been clear a week; the November volume step waits, as agreed.
